decisive_items: numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate
non-pitting edema of the left periorbital region
response.rationale: The presence of numerous dermal ectatic lymphatics on skin biopsy is consistent with lymphangioma, and the non-pitting edema is also consistent with this diagnosis, although angioedema is also a possible diagnosis based on the edema

rejected.why: Scleroderma is less likely due to the lack of other characteristic symptoms and findings
Lymphedema is less likely due to the localized nature of the edema and the presence of ectatic lymphatics on biopsy
Sjögren syndrome is less likely due to the lack of visual symptoms and other characteristic findings
